name: ranbir-portfolio
description: Ranbir Kumar portfolio static site with a lightweight Node backend for contact and grounded portfolio chat.

scripts.check: node --check server/index.js && node --check script.js && node --check script.min.js
scripts.build:assets: npx -y esbuild script.js --minify --outfile=script.min.js && npx -y esbuild styles.css --minify --outfile=styles.min.css
